_readme: Custom template patterns for /template-maps (L-018/P-7): a template authored as a small TILE of cell roles ('' void, '1' floor, '1s' floor slot, '2' platform, '2s' podium slot, '3s' high podium slot, '4' wall), applied to painted zones by repeat / halfdrop / stamp. Author new ones in /template-pattern-editor. Seeded 2026-07-15.

uffizi-spine-enfilade.label: Uffizi U-Spine Enfilade
uffizi-spine-enfilade.walk_rule: Enter at the head of the east spine and walk the 3-wide corridor pulled forward by the hero visible on-axis 27 cells ahead, dipping optionally through door gaps into three side rooms whose aligned doors form a second parallel vista, then turn west along the south corridor past the hero and exit on the enfilade axis.
uffizi-spine-enfilade.pacing_rule: Paired podium statues line the spine's inner wall in bays broken by door gaps (Vasari's three-bays-plus-narrow-bay rhythm), and every pause option sits off the clear lane so lingering never dams the flow; the one mandated stop is the raised dais step before the end-stopped hero.

guggenheim-serpentine.label: Guggenheim Switchback — spiral as serpentine descent
guggenheim-serpentine.museum: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum, New York
guggenheim-serpentine.walk_rule: Enter at the top (the elevator drop-off) and walk one un-branching serpentine: each 3-wide lane runs the full width, turns through a 3-cell gap at the alternating end of each partition, and empties onto the rotunda floor at the bottom where the hero stands on the atrium axis.
guggenheim-serpentine.pacing_rule: Movement never pauses the route — art bays are recessed into the solid partition stretches as stop pockets beside the flow, while the aligned see-through void windows (c6-c8) form the atrium axis that promises the hero podium from up to 27 cells away and re-shows passed works across lanes.

neue-nationalgalerie-free-plan.label: Mies Free-Plan Hall
neue-nationalgalerie-free-plan.walk_rule: Enter anywhere on the open top edge and drift freely through a column-free field; freestanding picture-walls and podia are obstacles to orbit, not corridors to follow, and the only fixed event is the on-axis hero at the hall's centre.
neue-nationalgalerie-free-plan.pacing_rule: Pacing comes from paired off-axis freestanding walls at each third of the walk that slow the drift into eddies, while the untouched central axis keeps a 13-cell promise to the hero so the visitor always chooses between lingering and advancing.

soane-cabinet-vista.label: Soane Cabinet — dense pockets on an end-stopped axis
soane-cabinet-vista.museum: Sir John Soane's Museum, 13 Lincoln's Inn Fields, London
soane-cabinet-vista.walk_rule: A 3-wide spine runs the full axis while staggered door gaps pull the body sideways into small 3x4 cabinet pockets; the eye keeps the long axial vista to the hero as the feet loop room by room.
soane-cabinet-vista.pacing_rule: Every five rows a cross-wall with corridor-facing niche slots compresses the walk back onto the spine, alternating pocket-dwell and corridor-glide, until the terminal dome room releases the width and the hero end-stops the 16-cell sightline just before a blind wall.

castelvecchio-endstopped-enfilade.label: Castelvecchio End-Stopped Enfilade
castelvecchio-endstopped-enfilade.walk_rule: Enter on the central axis and cross four rooms through aligned 3-wide door gaps; in each room the works sit off-axis so you drift sideways to a stop pocket and return to the line, until the axis delivers you into the hero bay where you circle the raised podium and exit through the off-axis side door behind it.
castelvecchio-endstopped-enfilade.pacing_rule: The hero is visible from the entrance through every aligned gap (a 24-cell promise), but four cross walls each impose a pause-and-drift beat before the axis is allowed to resolve, and the end-stop wall plus sideways exit ensure the vista terminates on the hero instead of continuing past it.

grande-galerie-axial.label: Grande Galerie — endless axial hang
grande-galerie-axial.walk_rule: Enter on axis and drift down the wide central lane toward the hero visible from the first step; at each bay, step sideways into the wall pocket to face a slot, then rejoin the flow, finally rounding the end-stopped hero to exit.
grande-galerie-axial.pacing_rule: Paired column cells pinch the 13-cell width every 4 rows into nine bays, and each bay's midpoint row carries a facing pair of wall slots — a metronome of stop-beats under one uninterrupted 33-cell sightline.

kanazawa-room-matrix.label: Kanazawa Free-Plan Room Matrix
kanazawa-room-matrix.museum: 21st Century Museum of Contemporary Art, Kanazawa
kanazawa-room-matrix.walk_rule: Enter anywhere along the open top edge; parallel streets (west 3-wide, central 3-wide, east lane) and full-width cross streets loop around sealed room-boxes, and the central street's promised hero room dead-ends, sending the walker back into the field to choose an exit route.
kanazawa-room-matrix.pacing_rule: Seeing is quantized into rooms — pace is the number of boxes you elect to enter and leave through the street field, not distance walked; corridor-hung slots give the streets themselves exhibition weight between stops.

sainsbury-false-perspective-enfilade.label: Sainsbury Enfilade (false-perspective axis)
sainsbury-false-perspective-enfilade.walk_rule: Enter on-axis at the top and the hero is already visible 28 cells away through every door gap; the 3-wide central nave carries the flow straight to the raised hero chamber, while offset side doors peel viewers into 3-cell-wide cabinet rooms and return them to the axis one bay deeper.
sainsbury-false-perspective-enfilade.pacing_rule: Cross walls every 5-6 rows frame the vista and the door gaps narrow as you go (5, 5, 3, 3 cells) — a false perspective that makes the hero feel farther then suddenly near — with the final threshold stepping up onto a platform where the 3s altarpiece slot is end-stopped by the terminal wall and the exit turns off-axis, exactly as the wing hands you sideways to the bridge.

altes-rotunda-hub.label: Altes Rotunda Hub
altes-rotunda-hub.walk_rule: The walker enters at the top gap onto the x=7 axis, crosses the vestibule and the screen-wall door at row 5, passes the stair-hall antechamber into the rotunda's north door at row 10, and from the rotunda's four doors (rows 10/18 at x=7, row 14 at x=4/x=10) makes out-and-back loops into the flanking wing corridors before leaving by the south door and the bottom gap.
altes-rotunda-hub.pacing_rule: Stopping concentrates inside the rotunda ring (the hero at 14,7 and the four 1s statue niches against the chamfered corners) and at the 2s podiums pressed against the wing outer walls, while the x=7 spine and the row-14 cross-axis stay entirely slot-free, so a pausing viewer never blocks the through-path.

bilbao-atrium-radial.label: Bilbao Atrium Radial
bilbao-atrium-radial.walk_rule: Enter the top gap into the lobby, pass the center door into the 5-cell-wide atrium shaft and ride it south, stepping through single-cell side doors (rows 6/11/16 left, 7/12/17 right) into 3x4 gallery pockets and back to the shaft each time, then take the narrow row-19 door into the 13-cell-wide boat gallery, weave among its podiums past the central hero, and leave through the terrace to the bottom gap.
bilbao-atrium-radial.pacing_rule: All stopping happens one door off the spine — inside the six radiating pockets and around the flanked hero in the long gallery — while the atrium shaft itself holds no slots, so the lit center always carries through-flow and every pause is a fresh departure that never dams the walk.

chichu-buried-cells.label: Chichu Buried Cells
chichu-buried-cells.walk_rule: Follow the single 1-wide corridor of "1" cells through the dark; each time a 1-cell doorway opens in the "4" wall, step off the spine into the cell, circle its lone slot, and return to the spine before descending further.
chichu-buried-cells.pacing_rule: Long wall-bound compression between rooms, one work per release — the corridor stretches (4+ cells of pure passage) must always be longer than the room they deliver you into, except the final hero chamber.

dia-beacon-field.label: Dia:Beacon Field of Bays
dia-beacon-field.walk_rule: Enter on the center line and drift sideways between column strips: each strip of '1' floor bounded by the x=3/7/11 column rhythm is one artist's bay, and you cross freely between them anywhere a divider stub does not block.
dia-beacon-field.pacing_rule: No sequence — long slow parallel drifts down open bays with lateral crossings, pausing longest in the single hero bay where one monumental work owns the entire strip.

libeskind-void-axis.label: Libeskind Void Axis
libeskind-void-axis.walk_rule: Walk the switchbacks: each full-width wall forces a hard turn, the three sealed void chambers on the central columns are never enterable — pass them along their flanking corridors, let the dead-end pockets beside each void deliver you to a slot facing blank wall, and cross the void line only at the open turn rows.
libeskind-void-axis.pacing_rule: Long quiet flank runs beside sealed voids alternate with abrupt forced turns; slots stay sparse (about one per fifteen walkable cells) and cluster at void walls and dead ends, so absence sets the rhythm and the single hero is met against the largest void.

louisiana-pavilion-chain.label: Louisiana Pavilion Chain
louisiana-pavilion-chain.museum: Louisiana Museum of Modern Art, Humlebæk
louisiana-pavilion-chain.walk_rule: Alternate walled pavilion chambers with 1-wide glass-link corridors that jog sideways between them, so the walker crosses an empty slotless passage and changes heading before every new room.
louisiana-pavilion-chain.pacing_rule: Room, breath, room — each pavilion is a dense cluster of works, each link is deliberately empty, and the single hero plinth waits in the last pavilion, earned by the whole walk.

castelvecchio-endstop-pinch.label: Castelvecchio (pinch edit)
castelvecchio-endstop-pinch.walk_rule: Enter on the central axis and cross four rooms through aligned 3-wide door gaps, drifting to off-axis stop pockets as before; in the hero bay the east flank is now walled into a final stop pocket, so you circle the podium on the west and the only route onward runs along its lowered south rank, carrying you one to two cells beneath the statue before the off-axis side door releases you down the exit corridor.
castelvecchio-endstop-pinch.pacing_rule: The hero stays withheld behind four pause-and-drift cross walls exactly as in the ancestor, but the resolution is now a pinch: the pulled-in east wall and lowered south podium rank force the exit path directly under the statue, so the climax lands at close range and maximum angular size instead of a polite orbit around a distant ring.

provenance.diagnosis: withheld hero scores patience now, but climax magnitude is modest — heroDeg peaks small
provenance.edit: Pulled the hero bay east wall in across the podium rows and lowered the podium south rank, so the only path to the exit passes 1-2 cells beneath the statue at a spatial pinch.

kanazawa-matrix-vista.label: Kanazawa Matrix (vista edit)
kanazawa-matrix-vista.walk_rule: Enter anywhere along the open top edge; parallel streets still loop around sealed room-boxes, but the hero now stands where the central street crosses the mid cross-street — one straight vista from the door — while the old dead-end room withholds a last small work that sends the walker back into the field to choose an exit.
kanazawa-matrix-vista.pacing_rule: Seeing stays quantized into rooms you elect to enter, but one promise is granted up front: the hero grows steadily down the central axis to a climax at the crossing, and every room after it is a chosen digression rather than a search.

provenance.diagnosis: perfect tau, zero hero vista — promise/rank1 always 0
provenance.edit: Re-sited the 3s from the dead-end room at (8,21) to (8,14), the central-street / mid-cross-street crossing, leaving a 1s in the vacated dead-end — two cells changed, no walls touched.

mezquita-hypostyle.label: Mezquita Hypostyle
mezquita-hypostyle.walk_rule: Enter and lose the door: every aisle repeats every other aisle, so walk by drift, not axis — pick any corridor, turn when a slot breaks the column rhythm, and let the off-axis hero (the mihrab) find you deep in the southeast of the field; the exit is just another gap in the wall, met the same way.
mezquita-hypostyle.pacing_rule: Metronomic: a column every second cell sets a constant beat with no crescendo and no vista; slots are rests scattered off-symmetry within the beat, the single hero is one held note — density never varies, so all pacing comes from the walker's own turns.

pompidou-plateau-libre.label: Pompidou Plateau Libre
pompidou-plateau-libre.walk_rule: Enter onto the open plateau and see the hero immediately, dead ahead down the clear central spine. Walk the free field in any order — servicing bays wall the edges, podium slots drift past on both flanks — but every path bends toward the centre, where the hero stands fully in the round before the spine releases you to the exit.
pompidou-plateau-libre.pacing_rule: No enforced sequence: pacing is self-set on one open floor. The hero is met early by eye and late by body — visible from the threshold, reached mid-walk, re-seen from behind on the way out. Slot podiums alternate left-right at even intervals like structural bays, giving a loose rhythm without ever interrupting the plateau.

teshima-droplet.label: Teshima Droplet
teshima-droplet.walk_rule: one path only: enter at the gap, serpentine the long outdoor approach for over half the tile's length, pass through the narrow neck into the droplet chamber, circle the single work, leave by the far gap
teshima-droplet.pacing_rule: the approach is the decompression — no slots, no incident, just walking; then everything at once in one chamber and nothing after; slot density is the lowest in the corpus by design

uffizi-spine-ordered.label: Uffizi Spine (order edit)
uffizi-spine-ordered.walk_rule: Enter at the head of the east spine and walk the 3-wide corridor pulled forward by the hero visible on-axis 27 cells ahead; each side room now files its offerings down the door-side wall in the order the descent meets them, so dipping through the door bands never rewinds the sequence; turn west along the south corridor past the hero and exit on the enfilade axis.
uffizi-spine-ordered.pacing_rule: Podium statues still line the spine's inner wall in Vasari's bay rhythm, and each room's three pieces stack just inside the door band from top to bottom so the dealt order and the walked order stay in step; every pause sits off the clear lane, and the one mandated stop remains the raised dais step before the end-stopped hero.

provenance.diagnosis: tau swings to -0.6: row-major dealing disagrees with the U-walk's encounter order
provenance.edit: Moved the nine side-room slot cells from scattered interior positions to a top-to-bottom file just inside each room's door band (column 8, door rows), so row-major slot reading now tracks the U-walk's encounter order while spine podiums, hero, walls, and all slot counts stay untouched.
